acceptance: UNRESOLVED_VIOLATIONS is empty and each former rewrite uses the standard translation path.
description:
## Problem
The text-level SQL rewrite check (tests/unit/sql_compat/test_core_sql_text_rewrite.py) found ten existing per-platform rewrites of SQL text in benchbox/core, listed in its UNRESOLVED_VIOLATIONS: ClickHouse LAG (read_primitives/queries.py), MySQL CAST (tpcds/maintenance_functions.py), Doris/StarRocks GROUP BY () (tpchavoc/dialect_compat.py), SQLite series and typed dates (transaction_primitives/benchmark.py), per-platform transactional rewrites and StarRocks BEGIN (transactional/benchmark_base.py), QuestDB CURRENT_TIMESTAMP (transactional/questdb_sql.py), T-SQL TOP 1 and per-platform column types (tuning/metadata.py), SingleStore function replacement (vector_search/queries.py).

## Change
Move each to the standard path: translate_sql_query, or a named fork rewrite through apply_rewrite, or SCHEMA_EMIT/type_map for column types; remove its UNRESOLVED_VIOLATIONS entry in the same change. One PR per area is fine.

## Verification rubric
Pass: UNRESOLVED_VIOLATIONS is empty; the affected benchmarks' golden corpus and translation tests show no unintended output change.
